finance.pricingRelationship: Each Aether package discloses its own cents-per-unit rate. Cash singles are not generated from conflicting provisional cash/Aether targets.
limitations: No simulated transaction is actual revenue or cash receipts.
Processing/dispute costs are configurable estimates, not a current fee quote.
Redemption allocation is illustrative; final accounting revenue recognition requires an approved policy.
Player conversion, purchase frequency and spending are hypothetical and may be zero.
Hosting, artwork/content and operations are independent owner-supplied assumptions.

recommendations: Retain the provisional 25/12/8 match Gold and 250 Gold guaranteed-new pack as an initial DEV baseline; tune observed participation before permanent policy approval.

A starter already completes its own Kindred. A different Kindred can be obtained by the 1500 Gold fixed bundle instead of six 300 Gold targeted packs; budget milestones describe this alternative saving strategy.
Keep first-copy completion separate from three-copy deck construction and tradeable additional sources. Premium all-set grants can accelerate collection; they never increase the 24-pack upper bound.
Review rotating free additional-copy pools: current free tradeable sources cover only six identities and casual schedules miss the twenty-match weekly quest.
Review cash singles versus Aether singles, package unit rates and the two-small-package one-cent anomaly before commercial policy approval.
assumptions: Nine deterministic profiles; Nature starter and actual default proposals. Normal AI competitive proxy is not ranked multiplayer.
Day-resolution collection timestamps are end-of-play-day upper bounds, not artificial collection delays. C's per-match model remains available for finer free-player timing.
Gold income includes assumed timely tutorial/objective/mastery/achievement claims. Aether comes only from hypothetical explicitly budgeted test packages; no live money or revenue exists.
Paying profiles prioritize up to two complete additional sets, then additional boosters. No universal cash/Aether exchange rate is assumed; unspent package units and budget change remain disclosed.
Nature weekly and Veteran additional cards follow their current explicit source identities. Mastery contributes Gold, not invented extra card rewards.

The active-trader profile makes at most four consensual one-for-one exchanges of earned N013 extras for other Kindreds' weekly cards; counterparty supply is conditional. Separate cohort markets verify conservation, scarcity and population imbalance.
No server policy is changed by this model. Retain Gold paths for all founders, independent sandbox origins and immutable match snapshots.
